## Flame v2.4.1

This is the first versioned release of the erathaowl Flame fork.

### Fixes
- Reliable application, bookmark and category reordering: validated requests, transactional database writes and correct drag-and-drop handling.
- Visibility toggles preserve custom ordering and bookmark category assignments.
- Application visibility survives Docker and Kubernetes synchronization unless a visibility label is explicitly configured.
- Improvements to management form state and error reporting.

### Build and verification
- Automated frontend build and backend/frontend regression checks.
- Multi-platform Docker images for `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64` on GHCR.

### Docker
```sh
docker pull ghcr.io/erathaowl/flame:v2.4.1
```
